lastCompletedStory.title: Wire container-config into ensure-up + fail-closed in runSidecar

nextStoryContext: US-003 wired container-config into the ensure-up path. Key changes: (1) EnsureWorkerContainerOptions gained configSpawnFn (optional, same shape as firewallSpawnFn). (2) ensureWorkerContainer calls applyConfigIfPresent UNCONDITIONALLY after applyFirewallIfPresent, threading opts.build.hostUid/hostGid into the chown step. (3) ContainerConfigError thrown on non-zero config exit. (4) makeProductionEnsureContainerFn creates configSpawnFn alongside firewallSpawnFn and passes both. (5) runSidecar has a new instanceof ContainerConfigError arm (mirrors FirewallError arm at ~1160): logs stderrTail + returns before runSidecarLoop. (6) buildChownExecArgv now accepts optional uid/gid args. (7) applyContainerConfig accepts optional ids bag {uid, gid} and forwards to buildChownExecArgv. (8) Private applyFirewallIfPresent + applyConfigIfPresent helpers extracted to keep biome complexity under 15. All 3070 tests pass, bun run check:all clean.

officialDocsValidated.lib: Docker CLI (docker exec -u flag + exit codes)
officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: docker exec -u flag accepts <name|uid>[:<group|gid>] (both bun:bun named form and 1000:1000 numeric form are valid). No constraints on running as root. Exit code 1 on failure (e.g., paused container). Implementation uses docker exec -u root for chown and docker exec (no -u) for node script; both confirmed correct.
